test_cases.description: Verify enrolled courses endpoint lists all active enrollments with live mastery and current active concept across courses.
Verify StudentPortalController defaults to first enrolled course and builds full context with active course, curriculum, and offline status.
Verify switching courses updates active context and subsequent queries reflect target course.
Verify safe switching invariant: course switch is strictly rejected (409 Conflict) while AI turn is generating.
Verify student cannot switch to a course they are not enrolled in (403 Forbidden).
Verify curriculum DAG navigation is strictly isolated per course and overlays mastery scores on concepts.
Verify assignments are strictly scoped per course with zero leakage across courses.
Verify assignments assigned to another Class Group do not leak to student.
Verify RAG sources and remedial notes are scoped strictly to course and student target.
Verify offline status endpoint returns accurate caching indicators.
Verify PySide6 Bridge facade multi-course slots integrate seamlessly with student controller and enforce turn cancellation invariant.
Verify student_dashboard.html contains course switcher dropdown, offline badge, and JS handlers.
